headword: {飛|と}ぶ{鳥|とり}を{落|お}とす{勢|いきお}い
reading: とぶとりをおとすいきおい
gloss: at the height of one's power; riding high

definitions.gloss: at the height of one's power; riding high
definitions.explanation: Such power or popularity that one could knock birds out of the sky: said of a person, company or group at its peak, whose influence nobody can resist.

examples.japanese: {飛|と}ぶ{鳥|とり}を{落|お}とす{勢|いきお}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧、{飛|と}ぶ{鳥|とり}を{落|お}とす{勢|いきお}いだ。
examples.english: That singer is at the height of their popularity right now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飛|と}ぶ{鳥|とり}を{落|お}とす{勢|いきお}いで、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{逆|さか}らえなかった→逆らう：02106_sakarau⟧。
examples.english: Back then he was at the peak of his power, and no one could stand up to him.

notes:
Used of people and organizations at their peak, often with a hint that the peak will pass (⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飛|と}ぶ{鳥|とり}を{落|お}とす{勢|いきお}いだった, once all-powerful).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {飛|と}ぶ{鳥|とり}を{落|お}とす{勢|いきお}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: a ... at the height of its power
- {飛|と}ぶ{鳥|とり}を{落|お}とす{勢|いきお}いだ: is riding high

- {破竹|はちく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧: unstoppable momentum, winning streak after streak
